### Breaking change for local Canvas MCP users

Local installations now start read-only. To keep editing, publishing, grading, or messaging, enable the specific tools you use. For page edits, enter `edit_page_content` under **Allowed write tools** in Claude Desktop, or set `ALLOWED_WRITE_TOOLS=edit_page_content` for another local client. Restart the client and check its tool list. Read-only users can keep the default. On shared HTTP or Azure servers, the operator controls the allowlist.

[Setup instructions for each client](https://github.com/vishalsachdev/canvas-mcp/blob/v1.19.0/README.md#enable-specific-write-tools)
